title: Association of end-stage renal disease with the prognosis and hemostasis of patients with atrial flimmern or coronary heart disease
summary: Vergleich der Prognose und des Gerinnungsstatus von Patienten mit unterschiedlichen Nierenfunktion, die gleichzeitig an Vorhofflimmern oder koronarer Herzkrankheit erkrankt sind.

interventions.name:
AF (atrial fibrillation)-study: patients on dialysis with atrial fibrillation 
CAD (coronary artery disease)-study: patients on dialysis with coronary artery disease
This study consists of two sub-studies focusing on patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and coronary artery disease (CAD). In the

AF-study: chronic renal insufficiency patients in stage 4 according to KDIGO with atrial fibrillation
CAD-study: chronic renal insufficiency patients in stage 4 according to KDIGO with coronary heart disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients over 18 years old with chronic kidney insufficiency from stage IV according to KDIGO
• known atrial fibrillation and/or coronary heart disease 
• Stable kidney retention parameters
• consistent administration of anticoagulants/platelet aggregation inhibitors and no medication change for at least 1 week, or no anticoagulants/platelet aggregation inhibitors due to high bleeding risk.
Exclusion criteria:
• Pregnant
• Patients with known coagulation disorders, liver insufficiency, or active cancer disease
• Acute kidney failure in the current hospital stay
• Severe thrombocytopenia (< 100,000/μl) or thrombocytosis (> 450,000/μl)
• Noncompliance, lack of consistent medication intake
